basics.name: Andrés Giraldo
basics.label: Software Developer
basics.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years at Ideamosmas, building Controlo and Exploreti end to end: Java 21 / Spring Boot 4 event-driven microservices, Nuxt 4 frontends, PostgreSQL, and CI/CD on Azure. I work with gentle-ai's Organic Driven Development (ODD) and test-first, and I build AI-assisted development workflows with Claude Code that take issues from Linear to merged PRs.

work.name: Ideamosmas
work.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer on Ideamosmas' two core products: Controlo, a multi-tenant ticketing, access-control and POS platform for events being rebuilt as event-driven microservices, and Exploreti, a tourism experiences marketplace for Colombia. I work end to end, from database and services to frontend, CI/CD and production, inside an AI-assisted engineering workflow built on gentle-ai's ODD.
responsibilities: Building and evolving 8 Java 21 / Spring Boot 4 microservices for Controlo (identity, catalog, commerce, validator, operations, fiscal, customers, storefront), with a PostgreSQL schema per service and Flyway migrations.
Designing event-driven integration with Azure Service Bus and the transactional outbox pattern, plus resilient service-to-service calls (OpenFeign, Resilience4j) and Redis rate limiting.
Implementing JWT auth with OAuth2 resource servers and client-credentials between services, with multi-tenant isolation enforced by ArchUnit tests.
Building Controlo's Nuxt 4 + Nuxt UI back-office and POS with a BFF pattern (server-side tokens in httpOnly cookies), plus Wompi payments and DIAN electronic invoicing.
Developing Exploreti end to end as a Nuxt 4 SSR app with Drizzle and PostgreSQL: a booking engine with transactional inventory locks, ePayco payments, a supplier portal, i18n and SEO.

Owning CI/CD and cloud: GitHub Actions and Bitbucket Pipelines building images to Azure Container Registry and deploying to Azure Container Apps, with Key Vault secrets and Prometheus/Log Analytics/Sentry observability.
Testing test-first: JUnit 5, AssertJ and Mockito, integration tests on Testcontainers, an 80% JaCoCo floor on domain code, Vitest, and Playwright end-to-end tests.
Working in Linear with one-week cycles, a Definition of Ready and Done, Conventional Commits, and PRs of about 400 lines, split into chained PRs when larger.

Working with gentle-ai's Organic Driven Development (ODD): small changes go straight to code, while larger features get a feature document with numbered specs and a task logbook, test-first implementation, reviewable work-unit commits and risk-based review.

Driving the team's AI-assisted workflow: I built the company's Claude Code plugin (linear-goal, workflow-decision), which takes agent-ready Linear issues through implementation, review and PR, alongside Engram memory and CodeGraph.

projects.name: Controlo
projects.description: B2B ticketing, access-control, and point-of-sale platform for events and venues (Ideamosmas), being rebuilt as a cloud-native microservices system. I work across the stack — Java 21 / Spring Boot 4 event-driven services on Azure plus a Nuxt 4 back-office — powering multi-channel sales (POS, web, kiosk, mobile) with real-time QR ticket validation.
highlights: Event-driven microservices (Java 21, Spring Boot 4) on Azure Container Apps
Database-per-service on PostgreSQL 16 with strict multi-tenancy
Custom RS256 JWT auth with role- and permission-based access control
Async messaging via Azure Service Bus with the transactional outbox pattern
Real-time QR ticket validation with in-memory (Caffeine) caching
Unified multi-channel sales: POS, web, kiosk, and mobile (PDA)
DIAN-compliant electronic invoicing for Colombia
Nuxt 4 + Nuxt UI back-office with a BFF (server-side JWT) pattern

projects.name: Exploreti
projects.description: Full-stack tourism marketplace for Colombia (Ideamosmas) where travelers discover, book, and pay for experiences — tours, parks, and attractions — offered by local suppliers. I work end-to-end on a Nuxt 4 app with a Drizzle/PostgreSQL backend, a real-time availability engine, secure payments, and a supplier portal for managing listings and reservations.
highlights: Full-stack Nuxt 4 (SSR + Nitro) with Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL 16
Slot-based booking engine with real-time availability and atomic inventory locks
Multiple payment methods (ePayco, PSE, Google Pay) with reconciliation jobs
Dual customer/supplier auth with OAuth (Google, Apple, Facebook)
Supplier portal: listings, availability, bookings, payouts, and QR ticket scanning
Marketing engine: coupons, flash sales, gift cards, referrals, and collections
HMAC-signed QR vouchers and a partner Sync API (HMAC-SHA256)
Multi-language (ES/EN/FR) with SEO: JSON-LD, sitemaps, and ISR caching

projects.name: NITOR — Ecommerce Platform
projects.description: Headless ecommerce platform I designed and built end to end, now live as NITOR, a professional beauty-supply store in Colombia. A Medusa v2 backend with 30+ custom modules and a Next.js storefront, built to grow into a reusable, Shopify-style product with pluggable payments and shipping.
highlights: Medusa v2 backend with 30+ custom modules, workflows and subscribers
Next.js 16 + React 19 storefront on the Medusa JS SDK
Wompi payments, cash on delivery and manual payment methods with approval flow
Cost-based suggested pricing, wholesale price tiers and sales/profit reports in the admin
Meilisearch product search with synonyms and a beauty diagnostic quiz
Branded transactional email, reviews, restock alerts and Colombian data-privacy compliance
Performance and SEO work: LCP tuning, structured data and redirects
Turborepo monorepo deployed with Docker Compose behind Nginx

Full EN/ES localization with SEO: sitemap, structured data and llms.txt
